func (m managedClient) rollbackFiles(transaction managedTransaction) map[string]string {
	service := fmt.Sprintf("[Unit]
Description=Rollback unconfirmed NetBird update
StartLimitIntervalSec=0
ConditionPathExists=%s/pending.json

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart="%s" netbird agent rollback --transaction %s
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5s
", managedDirectory, m.rollbackExecutable(transaction), transaction.TransactionID)
	trigger := transaction.RollbackDeadline.UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
	if trigger.Before(transaction.RollbackDeadline) {
		trigger = trigger.Add(time.Second)
	}
	timer := fmt.Sprintf("[Unit]
Description=Rollback deadline for managed NetBird

[Timer]
OnCalendar=%s
AccuracySec=1s
Persistent=true

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
", trigger.Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05 UTC"))
	return map[string]string{".service": service, ".timer": timer}
}

retention.description: Retains copy of executable, checks metadata, prunes old snapshot directories. Parent uses real test-executable child with conditional helper; no production CLI/systemd process qualified.

calendar.description: Pure timer/service string rendering; no timer is armed by this root.

Mock status/systemctl/enroll callbacks do not establish real NetBird, daemon, enrollment, systemd or OCI/Vault boundaries. Local storage/flock and child-process paths are source evidence only.
Protected files and sync call paths do not establish power-loss/crash durability. Linux procfs fsync, file permissions and conditional root-owner cases remain runtime-dependent.
